title: High-risk filter in PR list never flags large changes
scope:
# Summary

The "high risk" filter in the PR list never flags large changes — even PRs with thousands of lines changed are not marked high risk.

# Steps to Reproduce

1. Open the PR list.
2. Apply / view the high-risk filter.
3. Observe a PR with a very large diff (thousands of lines changed).

Expected: Large/high-impact PRs are flagged as high risk and surfaced by the high-risk filter.
Actual: No PRs get flagged as high risk, even ones with thousands of lines changed.

# Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] PRs with large diffs (e.g. thousands of lines) are flagged as high risk
- [ ] The high-risk filter surfaces those PRs
- [ ] The risk score/field is populated and the size threshold is correct
- [ ] Tests cover risk classification at boundary change sizes (just below / just above the threshold)

# Dev Hints

* Likely a broken risk-scoring calculation or filter predicate. Verify: is the risk field populated at all? Is the change-size threshold ever met? Is the filter comparing against the correct value?
